title: IronKnuckle Mack and Volvo public OEM source registry
purpose: Curated discovery index for manufacturer-hosted technical publications and official support resources. This file stores metadata and source links, not OEM manual or bulletin contents.

rules.diagnosticUseRequires: Authorized source access, document/revision verification, exact vehicle applicability, technical review, and confirmed commercial display/use rights.

sources.title: Mack Body Builder Instructions — Section 3: Electrical Wiring and Connections (VECU5)
sources.scope: PI, AN, GR, LR, TE; VECU5; exact build date and chassis configuration must be checked in source
sources.notes: Current public electrical/body-builder reference. Do not treat body-builder wiring as a complete service schematic or substitute for VIN-specific service information.
